releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.5.4 Complete Bug Fix & Visual Polishing Release:
- Clean Card Layouts: Removed conflicting in-header toggles from Storage Cleaner and CPU Power Plan cards.
- Unicode Glyphs & Typography: Completely resolved all mojibake encoding issues across buttons, badges, and sensor labels.
- Interactive In-App Updater: Live modal progress bar with download speed, reliable hot-swap binary replacement, and browser fallback.
- Battery Conservation: Active checkmark badges for 60% / 80% / 100% modes with dynamic card status pills.
- Instant Battery Diagnostics: Pre-queried ACPI design capacity query on launch with zero delay.
